label: From Kalam
quote: Matiltan is a village in the Usho Valley in Pakistan about 11 km away from Kalam.

value: Falak Sar, the tallest peak of Swat, can be seen from the village

value: Cold winters and mild summers in the Ushu valley
quote: Ushu Valley has a temperate climate, with cold winters and mild summers.
